newsitem.title: EGYPT: Six Russians killed in tourist bus crash in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Six Russians killed in tourist bus crash in Egypt.

text.p: Six Russian tourists and an Egyptian tour guide were killed on the Red Sea coast of Egypt on Thursday night when their bus and another vehicle collided, an interior ministry spokesman said on Friday.
The accident took place near the resort town of Hurghada, 400 km (250 miles) southeast of Cairo, he said. Five of the 29 Russians on the bus were injured, security sources added.
On Thursday afternoon in the same area, a Belgian woman tourist was killed and four French tourists injured when the car they were in collided with a truck, he added.
Egyptian resorts have been packed with record numbers of tourists over the Christmas and New Year holidays.
